verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions for context, run commands on your behalf, and explain output with annotations. It is enabled through an official optional AI plugin, and community hands-on use confirms it generates working commands such as an awk filter. Users note it is opt-in and requires their own API key (or a configurable OpenAI-compatible URL). Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the scope of delegation (multi-step or autonomous task execution, approval flow), and independent corroboration of command execution beyond command generation.
